mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent inflationary pressure.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO YoY growth < -2% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 250,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously decreases, it signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent consumer confidence improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to broader economic slowdown concerns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in housing market slowdown periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ growth < -1% does not correlate with subsequent recessionary conditions.
